meta_description:
15K likes, 62 comments - abhishekkarofficial on October 15, 2026: "India’s most profitable companies in FY2024-25 might surprise you! 💰
While Reliance Industries secured the third position, State Bank of India topped the list with a consolidated net profit of ₹77,561 crore, followed by HDFC Bank at ₹70,792 crore.
From SBI and HDFC Bank to Reliance Industries, ICICI Bank, TCS, ONGC, Coal India, ITC and Bharti Airtel, this ranking reveals the earning power of India’s biggest businesses.
But remember: the most profitable company is not automatically the best investment. Profit, valuation, growth and shareholder returns tell different stories.
Which company’s position surprised you the most? Comment below!
Follow Abhishek Kar for more insights on Indian companies, business, finance, banking, stock markets and the economy.

#IndianStockMarket #BusinessFinance #IndianEconomy".
